text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their third summer training camp together. 
Heading into the Tenno Sho (Autumn), they 
were eager to train hard here! But—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega pointed out that you weren't 
looking well, and told you to take a rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You truly realized how inherently caring 
she is, always striving to be a reliable 
big sister.
